notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content: Chalky's got some new costumes just in time for Halloween! Try them out just in time for spooky season, along with other small improvements!

notes.title: Rocky the Chalkbag Update
notes.content:
Hey! Got a more substantial update out for yall today :)

In Adventure Mode, you can now transform into Rocky the Chalkbag by holding Spacebar and staying still for 3 seconds. As Rocky, you can't move, but your friends can grab you as if you were a regular rock! Use this to help each other through difficult parts of the map!

Also, there's a new climbing gym! Hustle Hustle is super wide. Try out all of the 5 new routes there and see if you can optimize your time!

There were also a number of minor bug fixes, as usual.

Also... we have a Discord server now! Join and [i]hang[/i] out with us!

notes.title: Feb 23 Hotfix
notes.content:
Removed a VERY pesky invisible wall at the end of the Adventure Map. You should be able to see the credits roll now!

-Logan

notes.title: Feb 16 hotfix
notes.content:
Getting stranded on a mountain sucks. Some maps have been adjusted so that players can't get stuck :)

Let me know if you find any others, thanks!

-Logan
